title: 第140章 旧天庭的彻底崩塌第139章 仙秦龙魂百万兵马俑
slug: 先秦炼气两千年世人误闯天家
content_zh:
第140章旧天庭的彻底崩塌
它体内的天道法则瞬间被那股霸道的煞气搅碎，眼中的红光迅速黯淡下去，变成了一具真正的“死物”。
这样的场景，在战场的每一处都在发生。
兵马俑军团，就像一排最坚固的绞肉机，硬生生地将天道护法军团的阵线，撕开了一道道巨大的口子！
“怎么可能！这怎么可能！”
在后方督战的昊天上帝，看到这一幕，眼珠子都快瞪出来了。
他无法理解！
天道护法军团，那可是道祖压箱底的王牌！
是理论上足以镇压圣人的终极武力！
怎么会……
怎么会在一群泥腿子捏出来的陶俑面前，如此不堪一击？
他哪里知道，兵马俑军团的核心，根本不是那傀儡身躯，而是那百万秦军老兵的不灭战魂！
他们生前就是百战锐士，死后又在皇陵中被嬴政用人道龙气和无尽煞气温养了无数年，他们的战斗意志和杀伐经验，早已磨砺到了一个匪夷所思的境界。
相比之下，天道护法军团虽然力量强大，但不过是一群没有灵魂、只知道执行命令的傀儡。
在真正的百战精兵面前，他们就像是一群拿着神兵利器的孩童，空有力量，却根本不知道该如何战斗！
就在天道护法军团的阵线被兵马俑冲得七零八落之时，截教的仙人们也动手了！
“哈哈哈！宵小之辈，吃我一鞭！”
赵公明骑着黑虎，如同一道黑色的闪电，直接冲进了那些旧天庭正神的阵中。
他手中的金色长鞭挥舞如龙，每一鞭落下，都伴随着一声惨叫。
那些曾经高高在上的雷部、火部天君，在他的金鞭之下，连一个回合都走不过，就被打得神魂俱灭，从空中坠落。

“雕虫小技，也敢放光？”
一个手持宝塔，自以为是的托塔天王李靖，看到赵公明凶猛，企图用自己的玲珑宝塔将他镇压。
赵公明看都懒得看他一眼，只是祭起了头顶的二十四颗定海神珠。
那宝塔刚飞到半空，就被一颗蔚蓝色的珠子轻轻一撞。
“咔嚓！”
一声脆响，这件后天功德灵宝，当场就碎成了漫天齑粉。
“噗！”
李靖心神受创，喷出一口神血，还没等他反应过来，另一颗珠子已经砸在了他的天灵盖上。
红的白的，溅了一地。
另一边，三霄娘娘更是如同虎入羊群。
云霄的混元金斗一出，金光所过之处，成片成片的天兵天将，连人带甲，都被直接削去了顶上三花，化作凡人，惨叫着从空中坠落。
碧霄和琼霄则催动着金蛟剪，那两条由上古蛟龙化作的剪刀，在空中“咔嚓咔嚓”地交错飞舞。
每一次剪合，都有一位所谓的“正神”被拦腰剪成两段，连元神都来不及逃出，就当场毙命！
战斗，从一开始就呈现出了一边倒的屠杀态势！
那些旧天庭的正神们，养尊处优了亿万年，早就忘了该如何战斗。
他们所谓的“神威”，在这些从封神血战中杀出来的截教悍将面前，简直就是一个笑话！
“顶住！都给我顶住！不许退！”
昊天上帝看着节节败退的阵线，急得满头大汗，声嘶力竭地咆哮着。
然而，根本没有人听他的。
恐惧，如同瘟疫一般，在天道大军中蔓延开来。

他们终于意识到，他们面对的，根本不是一群可以随意拿捏的凡人。
content_en:
Chapter 140 The Complete Collapse of the Old Heaven
The laws of heaven in its body were instantly shattered by the overbearing evil spirit, and the red light in its eyes quickly dimmed, turning it into a real "dead thing".
Scenes like this happen everywhere on the battlefield.
The terracotta warriors and horses were like a row of the strongest meat grinders, forcibly tearing open huge holes in the Tiandao Guardian Army's front line!
"How is this possible! How is this possible!"
God Haotian, who was supervising the battle from the rear, almost bulged his eyes when he saw this scene.
He couldn't understand it!
The Heavenly Protector Corps, that is Dao Ancestor’s trump card!
It is the ultimate force that is theoretically enough to suppress the saint!
How could it be...
How could he be so vulnerable in front of a group of pottery figurines made of clay legs?
How did he know that the core of the Terracotta Warriors and Horses Army was not the puppet body at all, but the immortal fighting souls of the millions of veterans of the Qin Army!
They were warriors who fought in countless battles during their lifetime, and after their death, they were nourished by Ying Zheng in the imperial mausoleum for countless years with human dragon energy and endless evil energy. Their fighting will and killing experience have been honed to an incredible level.
In contrast, although the Tiandao Protector Corps is powerful, they are just a group of soulless puppets who only know how to execute orders.
In front of the real elite soldiers, they are like a group of children with magical weapons. They have no power but no idea how to fight!
Just when the line of the Tiandao Protector Corps was rushed to pieces by the terracotta warriors and horses, the immortals who intercepted the teaching also took action!
"Hahaha! You young man, please give me a whip!"
Zhao Gongming rode the black tiger, like a black lightning, directly into the formation of those old heavenly gods.
The golden whip in his hand was swung like a dragon, and every time the whip fell, it was accompanied by a scream.
Those once high-ranking Heavenly Lords of the Thunder and Fire Departments could not even make it through one round under his golden whip before they were beaten to death and fell from the sky.
"How dare you show off your small skills?"
Li Jing, the self-righteous pagoda king holding a pagoda, saw Zhao Gongming's ferocity and tried to suppress him with his exquisite pagoda.
Zhao Gongming didn't even bother to look at him, he just held up the twenty-four Dinghai Divine Pearls on his head.
As soon as the pagoda flew into the air, it was lightly hit by a blue bead.
"Crack!"
With a crisp sound, this acquired meritorious treasure was shattered into powder all over the sky on the spot.
"Poof!"
Li Jing was traumatized and spurted out a mouthful of divine blood. Before he could react, another bead had already hit his Tianling Cap.
Red and white, splashed all over the floor.
On the other side, Empress Sanxiao was like a tiger among sheep.
As soon as Yunxiao's Hunyuan Golden Dou came out, wherever the golden light passed, swarms of heavenly soldiers and generals, even their armors, were directly cut off from their tops, turned into mortals, and fell from the sky screaming.
Bixiao and Qiongxiao urged the golden dragon scissors, and the two scissors transformed from ancient dragons flew intertwined in the air.
Every time the cut was made, a so-called "righteous god" was cut into two pieces at the waist. Even the soul had no time to escape and was killed on the spot!
The battle showed a one-sided massacre from the beginning!
Those righteous gods of the old heaven have been pampered for hundreds of millions of years and have long forgotten how to fight.
Their so-called "divine power" is simply a joke in front of these fierce warriors who came out of the bloody battle of Conferred Gods!
"Hold on! Hold on! Don't retreat!"
God Haotian looked at the retreating front, sweating profusely and roaring at the top of his lungs.
However, no one listened to him.
Fear, like a plague, spread among the army of Heavenly Dao.
They finally realized that what they were facing was not a group of mortals who could be manipulated at will.
